verdict.rationale: LightSprint's pricing page claims "1,000+ integrations via MCP" and names connectable services such as Google Drive, Notion and SharePoint, so its agents act as MCP clients. That claim is a single marketing line with no documentation on adding custom or arbitrary MCP servers, how they are configured, or how agents call their tools. Missing for 10: documented setup for plugging in user-chosen or custom MCP servers, details on tool invocation and transport support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: 1,000+ integrations via MCP Connect Google Drive, Granola, Notion, Microsoft SharePoint, and more.
